title: Sources: Nvidia appealed to Taiwanese officials after its manager was charged over chip smuggling, and sought advice from TSMC, which declined to get involved (Mackenzie Hawkins/Bloomberg)
summary: Mackenzie Hawkins / Bloomberg: Sources: Nvidia appealed to Taiwanese officials after its manager was charged over chip smuggling, and sought advice from TSMC, which declined to get involved — Nvidia Corp. appealed to Taiwanese officials after prosecutors on the island accused an employee of helping to smuggle AI chips into China …
